headword: {新品同様|しんぴんどうよう}
gloss: like new; as good as new

definitions.gloss: like new; as good as new; in mint condition
definitions.explanation: Describes a used item that is in excellent condition, virtually indistinguishable from a brand-new product.

examples.japanese: {新品同様|しんぴんどうよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧です。
フリマ⟦アプリ→アプリ：04722_apuri⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{新品同様|しんぴんどうよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦バッグ→バッグ：00008_baggu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つけた→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I found a like-new bag on a flea market app.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{中古|ちゅうこ}→中古：03479_chuuko⟧⟦パソコン→パソコン：01538_pasokon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{新品同様|しんぴんどうよう}で、⟦{傷|きず}→傷：02201_kizu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{汚|よご}れ→汚れ：03186_yogore⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧まったく⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: This used computer is like new, with no scratches or dirt at all.

notes:
A four-character compound combining ⟦{新品|しんぴん}→新品：08303_shinpin⟧ (new item) and ⟦{同様|どうよう}→同様：01654_douyou⟧ (same as, equivalent to). Very commonly seen in online marketplaces, second-hand shops, and product listings to indicate excellent condition.

USAGE:
Used as a no-adjective: {新品同様|しんぴんどうよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun. Also used as a standalone description in product listings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新品同様|しんぴんどうよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧: like-new condition
- {新品同様|しんぴんどうよう}⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧: item in like-new condition
- {新品同様|しんぴんどうよう}・⟦{未使用|みしよう}→未使用：21316_mishiyou⟧: like-new/unused (listing categories)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{未使用|みしよう}→未使用：21316_mishiyou⟧: unused — literally never been used
- ⟦{美品|びひん}→美品：14997_bihin⟧: item in beautiful/excellent condition — slightly less than new
- ⟦{中古|ちゅうこ}→中古：03479_chuuko⟧: secondhand, used — general term without implying condition quality
